body.x: Brands, importers and distributors that sell hair dryers under their own names need a manufacturer that can build to their specifications, from the motor type to the accessories.

Jieyang Changrong Industry Co., Ltd., a Chinese manufacturer that operates under the INJOY brand and is led by Huang Daming, supplies that kind of OEM and ODM service. At KES 2026, the company is showing its hair dryer range and OEM and ODM capabilities, including new models of high-speed hair dryers, two of which come with an accessory protected by a utility model patent. It says this is the second time it has shown these models.

The company says it has grown over more than 30 years into a manufacturer that covers mold design and development and the production of personal hair styling appliances and kitchen appliances. It has more than 30 technical and management staff and a 30,000-square-meter site, and it has made hair dryers for more than 10 years, with a daily capacity of 3,000 units. Its dryers use BLDC, DC and AC motors, including high-speed models, and it offers customized product development and private-label manufacturing.

INJOY exports to Russia, Italy, Spain, Serbia, Peru, Ecuador, Japan, South Korea, Indonesia, the United Arab Emirates, Kazakhstan and India, among other markets, and says its products sell in more than 30 countries and regions. The company holds BSCI, ISO 9001 and ISO 14001 certifications.

Jieyang Changrong wants to expand in South Korea and other international markets and is looking for brands, importers and distributors interested in hair dryers and OEM and ODM services. It plans to develop new partnerships and introduce the high-speed models to more markets.

KES 2026, the 57th Korea Electronics Show, runs Oct. 13 to Oct. 16 at COEX Halls A and B in Seoul. Alongside the co-located XR & Spatial Computing Show, the event features X-SPACE 2026, a special exhibition covering digital twins, industrial XR, spatial intelligence, XR devices and spatial computing platforms. The Innovation Awards ceremony takes place on Oct. 13.
